title: One plan we all share
alt: Six children and a seated adult raise their hands in a circle; a wheelchair user joins the ring.
scene: Six diverse children in a loose classroom circle; one uses a wheelchair pulled into the ring. Every child raises one hand. An adult sits cross-legged at child height as part of the circle, also raising one hand. Plain walls, warm daylight.
prompt: Use case: educational child-friendly illustration. Bright, simple flat artwork with large clear shapes, light ivory background, friendly to six-year-olds. Wide lesson composition with generous clean margins. Six diverse children in a loose classroom circle; one uses a wheelchair pulled into the ring. Every child raises one hand. An adult sits cross-legged at child height as part of the circle, also raising one hand. Plain walls, warm daylight. Children visibly differ in skin tone, hair and build. No adult towering over a child, pointing, shaming or dominating. No prohibition signs, red slashes or crossed-out symbols. Absolutely no words, letters, numerals, writing, captions, labels, logos or watermark; paper and walls must be blank. The native application will add editable captions.
